question: Is the Commission considering extending the scope of Directive 2019/633 to sectors outside the agri-food sector, including the cosmetics sector, and using Article 114 TFEU as the legal basis for such an amendment?

As part of the revision of the Unfair Trading Practices Directive, does the Commission plan to protect all suppliers of fast-moving consumer goods, regardless of product categories, given that cosmetics producers, like food producers, are exposed to unfair practices from retail chains?

What is the anticipated timeline for the revision of the Unfair Trading Practices Directive and the possible extension of its scope to non-agricultural sectors, and what role does the Commission envisage for Member States, in particular for Poland, in shaping these changes within the Council of the EU?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (26.11.2026) The evaluation of Directive (EU) 2019/6331 (‘the Directive’) identified gaps in the protection against unfair trading practices in the agri-food supply chain2.

Building on the evaluation and extensive consultation activities, the revision of the Directive aims to address these gaps, taking into account the specific vulnerabilities faced by farmers and small suppliers within the agri-food chain and the negative consequences of bargaining power imbalances on them.

The revision of the Directive therefore focuses on the specific challenges arising from bargaining power imbalances in the agri-food supply chain, while carefully assessing if an extension of the scope is necessary based on the evidence and in consistency with the agricultural legal basis. The Commission intends to present a revision proposal, accompanied by an impact assessment.

The proposal will be examined by the European Parliament and the Council under the ordinary legislative procedure, giving Member States, including Poland, the opportunity to contribute to shaping the final legal text.
1 Directive (EU) 2019/633 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2019 on unfair trading

practices in business-to-business relationships in the agricultural and food supply chain, OJ L 111, 25.4.2019, pp. 59. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2019/633/oj/eng. 2 COM/2025/728 final https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=celex:52025DC0728.
